name: Hiring pipeline status report
summary: Each week your people lead or founder sees every open role on one page: applications at each stage, days open against the target, roles running late, pass-through between stages, which sources lead to interviews, and every blocker with its owner. It counts; it never assesses a candidate.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own rules for a counts-only hiring report: fixed export columns with a stop on any mismatch, pass-through that leaves out people still waiting at a stage, a minimum before any rate is shown, personal details never read, blockers carried until marked settled, owners taken only from the inputs, and the tests and worked example.

sources.contribution: A time limit for each pipeline stage; a role treated as ageing when it has been open for long with few people at the later stages; and a weekly review of counts by stage and of what is holding each role up, such as interviewer availability.

Measuring pass-through at each step, from the people who reached a stage to those who went on from it; judging each source by the share of its applicants who reach an interview; leaving periods on hold out of the time a role has been open, where they are tracked (the customization option on days open); and a short periodic report that pairs its figures with actions.
